channel.title: EU INC
channel.description: Track developments on EU-Inc (28th Regime) - European startup incorporation harmonization initiative

item.title: EU INC | 2026-W10
item.description:
eu-inc Weekly | 2026-W10

EU-Inc gained momentum this week with updated legislative timing and fresh analysis from legal and consulting perspectives on its potential impact across sectors.

This Week

🆕 EU–INC roadmap and Grant Thornton analysis(https://www.eu-inc.org/roadmap) (eu-inc.org) The official roadmap now specifies Q1 2026 for the European Commission's legislative proposal, firming up previously vague timing.

EU‑INC: A Game‑Changing EU Company Structure for Tech Startups(https://www.grantthornton.se/en/insights/article/eu-inc-a-game-changer-for-europes-tech-startups/) (Grant Thornton) Grant Thornton examines how the voluntary pan-European legal entity could specifically benefit tech startup formation and scaling.

EU Inc. – The truly European company structure(https://www.mcdermottlaw.com/insights/eu-inc-the-truly-european-company-structure/) (McDermott) McDermott covers President von der Leyen's January 20 World Economic Forum address positioning EU-Inc within Europe's broader resilience strategy.

Why EU-INC Matters For Europe's Biggest Builders(https://www.forbes.com/councils/forbesfinancecouncil/2026/02/24/why-eu-inc-matters-for-europes-biggest-builders/) (Forbes) Forbes explores how private equity and construction sector players view EU-Inc's potential for managing cross-border operations.

item.title: EU INC | 2026-W09
item.description:
eu-inc Weekly | 2026-W09

EU Inc. dominated policy analysis this week as law firms and news outlets digested President von der Leyen's Davos announcement of the new European company structure.

This Week

EU Inc. – The truly European company structure (McDermott) Provides legal analysis of von der Leyen's World Economic Forum address that aimed to "write corporate legal history" with the EU Inc. proposal.

EU Inc: Brussels' plan for a single company law across Europe (Euronews) Explains the "28th regime" concept as an optional structure designed to help European startups scale faster and compete globally.

EU Inc.: Founders and companies with expansion plans must now think strategically (Taylor Wessing) Advises founders and companies on strategic considerations following von der Leyen's push to make business formation much easier in Europe.

Radar

- Commission targeting parliamentary approval by end of March for the EU Inc. framework

item.title: EU INC | 2026-W08
item.description:
eu-inc Weekly | 2026-W08

EU-Inc gained major momentum this week with Ursula von der Leyen's endorsement at Davos and growing industry support for the pan-European startup entity proposal.

This Week

The European Commission launches EU Inc., the long-awaited '28th regime' for startups (Tech.eu) The Commission formally announced EU Inc as a single, optional EU-wide legal entity that sits alongside national company structures rather than replacing them.

You can just do things – Creating a pan-European legal entity, the right way (Andreas Klinger) Klinger outlines how EU-Inc could create a single playbook for European founders with online entity creation, cross-border stock options, and standardized legal documents.

Momentum builds for EU-wide company status (Science|Business) Von der Leyen directly referenced the "EU-Inc" campaign at Davos, acknowledging the specific recommendations from startup founders and investors.

EU-Inc : les prémices d'un Delaware européen ? (What's Up EU) French analysis positions EU-Inc as Europe's answer to Delaware's corporate dominance, creating a true single market for entrepreneurs.

item.title: EU INC | 2026-W07
item.description:
eu-inc Weekly | 2026-W07

A quiet week for EU incorporation policy, with limited new content surfacing across monitoring sources.

This Week

EU–INC — One Europe. One Standard. — Pan-European legal entity. (brave) A detailed proposal for creating a standardized pan-European legal entity specifically designed to help startups scale across EU borders.

item.title: EU INC | 2026-W06
item.description:
eu-inc Weekly | 2026-W06

The week was dominated by Ursula von der Leyen's official announcement of EU-INC at Davos, sparking significant discussion across startup and policy circles about Europe's new pan-European company structure.

This Week

🆕 What is EU-INC and its plan to make European businesses borderless? (Euronews) Provides concrete details on the promised 48-hour digital incorporation framework that would unify Europe's fragmented market.

EU unveils EU‑Inc at Davos, sending 'very strong signal' to founders and investors (Impact Loop) Captures founder and investor reactions to the Davos announcement, highlighting the startup community's enthusiasm for the single rulebook approach.

EU Inc Is Confirmed. What That Means? (The Recursive) Analyzes the implications of von der Leyen's official confirmation for the CEE startup ecosystem specifically.

Momentum builds for EU-wide company status (Science Business) Examines the broader policy momentum behind EU-wide company structures amid Europe's push to retain AI talent.
